latest.t: Taiwan chipmaker TSMC explores Texas investment to expand production in the US
latest.d: HONG KONG (AP) — Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is exploring potential investments in Texas to expand its chip production in the United States, the advanced chipmaker said after posting another record profit on strong artificial intelligence demand.

stories.summary: TSMC reported record Q3 results with revenue up 41% to $46.7 billion and profit up 68.7%, driven by AI chip demand, while exploring Texas expansion and facing capacity battles among Nvidia, Apple, and AMD. Apple appears only as one of several customers competing for limited AI chip capacity.
